title: Priority Pointer Wrap-Around Error (3 Masters)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [DEADLOCK] last_gnt=3 with no master at index 3; arbiter hung
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (gnt_done) last_gnt <= last_gnt + 1;  // Wraps to 3 for a 3-master design
expected_root_cause: The pointer increments unconditionally past the maximum master index (2), wrapping to index 3 which has no master, causing the arbiter to deadlock waiting for a non-existent request.
description: The pointer increments past master 2 and wraps to 3, an index with no master, causing the arbiter to stall waiting for a request that never comes.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [DEADLOCK] last_gnt=3 with no master at index 3; arbiter hung
